cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

mechanism: A grants a discreet rescue only after the main performer explicitly acknowledges needing the supposedly superior understudy.
confusable: Status must affect the transaction, not merely decorate a demand for admission.
comparison: A time-sensitive private acknowledgment differs from the assembly alternative's practical physical dependence.
seedUse: Canonical S01-b supplies superiority despite an ostensibly assisting role; D01-b supplies resisting dependence and D01-a the eventual explicit request. New backstage setting is locally authored.
